title: 第13章 护送任务第14章 做爱做的事

第13章 护送任务
1周第7日，经历了昨天的战事，林天变得有些沉默了，少了份玩世不恭，多了份稳重冷静。
麾下的神赐战士战死过半，只剩下1阶长枪兵20名，花妖50名，2阶弓箭手30名，矮人10名，英雄空间中还有不用于参战的农民100名和小精灵100个（即使是昨天那么惨烈的战斗，也忍着没用使用。其实即使他们加入战场，作用也非常有限）。由于兵力不足，某宅现在严重缺乏安全感，出于对兵力的渴望，某宅进入系统准备建造三阶兵种建筑时，发现了一些不一样的东西。
精灵族的三阶兵种建筑很正常，但人族却有两个可建造选项“护卫营”和“剑士营”，系统一如即往的吝啬，没有给出任何可用提示。林天仔细回想了一下以前玩游戏的记忆，记得英雄无敌3里是有十字军战士的，有双刀技能，而英雄无敌5里是护卫，有减少友军所受远程伤害的能力，看来变化就在这里。
“建造人族3阶剑士营－3000！招募剑士30名，－1500！”
“建造精灵族3阶精灵靶场－3000！招募精灵射手30名，－1500！”剩余36000金。
人族3阶剑士，沿用了英雄无敌3的造型，身高1米8左右，铁甲、铁盔、铁护腿，披挂整齐如同钢铁堡垒，一把长长的双手大剑，标志着他们是崇尚进攻型的武器战士！无疑，如果选择的是护卫营，招募出来的，肯定是装备剑盾的，防御型的防御战士了。
剑士看起来虽然很威武，但在某死宅的心里，他们跟旁边的这群女性精灵比起来，那就是个渣……
精灵族3阶精灵射手，沿用了英雄无敌3的美丽造型，足蹬铮亮的高跟战靴，完全把曲线优美的小腿紧紧包括起来，比林天略矮的她们，看起来娇小可爱，小鸟依人。容貌个个如同精美的艺术品一样，都是美丽动人，身穿着明显具有精灵华丽审美情趣的银色亮甲，到处都是大片华丽的金边镂空装饰，这些明显追求华美多于防御的设计，让这些美丽的女人们，处处漏出富有弹性的白嫩肌肤，手执华美的精灵角弓，连弓弦都是高级兽筋，能把人族弓箭手活活气死。特别是下身装备着银色的超短战裙，直接暴露出整个平坦的小腹和可爱的肚脐，更别提那短短的战裙与高跟战靴之间，露出的大段紧致而光滑的性感大腿……只要看看某宅现在目不转睛的花痴像，就能得知，他完全被这些漂亮的女妖精给俘虏了！
丢人丢大发了，你妹的！
林天并没有把这批新战士召唤出来护卫自己，甚至把其他战士也都收进英雄空间，只保留了20名花妖在周围探路。
那是因为他已经进入了精灵森林的势力范围……他就这么想死吗？难道新招募的士兵，又让他自信心膨胀了不成？
当然不是！那是因为昨天他善心大发，答应护送幸存的14位精灵奴隶返回精灵森林。
任务：护送。要求护送幸存的精灵奴隶安全返回！完成将获得经验值1000，金币1000。失败将扣除同等经验和金币。
这是林天第一次接触到任务，一直以来某宅都以为英雄无敌系统取消了任务系统，因为以前他曾经尝试着从佣兵大厅接任务，但这些任务不被系统承认，没想到在这里居然意外的获得了护送任务，而且有经验值的奖励，这让他颇有点小纠结。
改进后的系统，并没有明确显示经验值数值，只用一条经验柱来表示，这条类似进度条的经验柱，被注满即可升级，具体1000经验值有多少就只能靠猜了。
正因为进入精灵森林的势力范围，所以林天把人族的战士都收起来，还有矮人也收起来。那是因为在这片大陆上，矮人与精灵并不是一家，完全是2个不同的种族，某宅可不想被守旧的精灵们，误认为是捕奴队而被追杀到死。要是有可能，他自己都想躲进英雄空间，精灵猎人的利箭不认人的。保留花妖是因为她们亲近森林，和精灵是一家，一方面也可以保护自己，显示自己是无害的。所有的精灵奴隶自然全部都已经松绑了，但林天并没有能力解除他们身上的魔法禁锢，不知道以后学会水系的疗伤术能不能解除（游戏中的疗伤术有个附加功能是可以移除一个不良效果，高级的急救帐篷也有这能力）。
一枝木箭插在了前面探路的花妖身前，更多的是拦阻的意味而非直接开战。这让林天大大的松了一口气。用精灵语大声说：“我们没有恶意，我们从恶毒的捕奴队里救下了一批精灵，现在给你们护送回来了！”可能是系统对穿越人士的优待，只要林天听过的语言，他就能听懂并马上学会，之前路上他就专门接近这些精灵奴隶学习精灵语，现在虽然文字书写方面还有待提高，但基本的交流已经没有障碍了。
前方密林中闪现出几个画满面纹的精灵猎人，这些精灵只在战斗或进行军事活动时才会额外画上面纹，这是她们古老的传统。林天举起了双手表示并无恶意，同时示意，让精灵奴隶中的一位去与她们交涉。过不了一会，密林中又陆续站出了二十多位精灵族人，甚至还有一棵老树人，就从林天左侧不远处解除了伪装，爬了起来，这位6米多高巨人的突然行动，把近在咫尺却完全没心理准备的某宅吓了一跳……
这些精灵族战士，将幸存的十几个精灵奴隶接走。

提示：护送任务完成，获得1000经验和1000金币。
提示：获得大陆精灵族少量声望，目前状态提升为冷淡。
经验柱前进了40%左右，这种实实在在进步的感觉，让林天神清气爽。金库剩余37000金。
另外还有少量的大陆精灵族声望是啥意思？某宅猜想很可能就是友好度，提升了之后还只是冷淡，那之前肯定是敌对有木有？是不是等以后跟她们的声望高了，可以随意攻略漂亮的精灵妹子吗？哈哈！该死的宅男又不合时宜地进入了YY模式。
结果现实是，精灵猎人们很委婉的要求客人止步，后转齐步走！不然就弓箭伺候……
这让还在想象自己大受精灵mm欢迎的死宅梦想立马破灭，还是去先攻略我自己的精灵射手mm吧！她们可比你们漂亮多了，真要把她们都召唤出来，你们这些村姑绝对会自卑到死！某男腹诽。
任务完成，也不留恋！
萨，一寇！
content_en:
Chapter 13 Escort Mission
On the 7th day of week 1, after experiencing yesterday's battle, Lin Tian became a little silent, less cynical and more steady and calm.
More than half of the god-given warriors under his command were killed in the battle, leaving only 20 level 1 spearmen, 50 flower demons, 30 level 2 archers, 10 dwarves, and 100 farmers and 100 elves in the hero space who were not used to participate in the battle (even in yesterday's brutal battle, they could not bear to use them. In fact, even if they joined the battlefield, their role would be very limited). Due to the lack of troops, a certain house is now seriously insecure. Out of the desire for troops, a certain house discovered something different when it entered the system to build a third-level military building.
The elves' third-level troop buildings are normal, but the humans have two buildable options: "Guard Camp" and "Swordsman Camp". The system is as stingy as ever and does not give any usable prompts. Lin Tian carefully recalled the memory of playing games before. He remembered that in Heroes of Might and Magic 3, there were crusaders with double-blade skills, while in Heroes of Might and Magic 5, there were guards, with the ability to reduce the long-range damage suffered by friendly troops. It seems that the change is here.
"Build a human level 3 swordsman camp - 3000! Recruit 30 swordsmen, -1500!"
"Build a level 3 elf shooting range -3000! Recruit 30 elf shooters, -1500!" There was 36,000 gold left.
The third-level swordsmen of the human race follow the appearance of Heroes of Might and Magic 3. They are about 1.8 meters tall. They wear iron armor, iron helmets, and iron leggings. They are neatly dressed like a steel fortress. A long two-handed sword marks them as warriors who advocate offensive weapons! Undoubtedly, if you choose a guard camp, the ones you recruit will definitely be defensive warriors equipped with swords and shields.
Although the swordsmen looked mighty, in the heart of a dead man, they were just scum compared to the group of female elves next to them...
The level 3 elf shooters of the Elf Tribe follow the beautiful style of Heroes of Might and Magic 3. They wear shiny high-heeled combat boots that completely cover their graceful calves. Slightly shorter than Lin Tian, they look petite and cute, like little birds. They are all as beautiful as exquisite works of art. They are all wearing bright silver armor that clearly has the gorgeous aesthetic taste of the elves. There are large and gorgeous gold-rimmed hollow decorations everywhere. These designs obviously pursue beauty more than defense, so that these beautiful women have elastic white and tender skin everywhere. They hold gorgeous elven horn bows, and even the bowstrings are made of high-grade animal sinews, which can make human archers alive. In particular, the lower body is equipped with a silver mini-skirt, which directly exposes the entire flat belly and cute navel, not to mention the large section of tight and smooth sexy thighs exposed between the short skirt and high-heeled boots... Just look at the nymphomaniac figure of a certain house, and you will know that he is completely captured by these beautiful female seductresses!
Shame on Dafa, you sister!
Lin Tian did not summon these new warriors to protect him, and even took other warriors into the hero space, leaving only 20 flower demons to explore the surroundings.
That's because he has entered the sphere of influence of the Elf Forest... Does he really want to die? Did the newly recruited soldiers inflate his self-confidence?
Of course not! That's because yesterday he showed great kindness and agreed to escort the 14 surviving elf slaves back to the elf forest.
Mission: Escort. Request that the surviving elf slaves be escorted back safely! Upon completion, you will receive 1,000 experience points and 1,000 gold coins. Failure will result in the equivalent experience and gold coins being deducted.
This is the first time Lin Tian has come into contact with missions. He has always thought that the Heroes Invincible system has canceled the mission system, because he once tried to receive missions from the mercenary hall, but these missions were not recognized by the system. Unexpectedly, he unexpectedly obtained them here.It was an escort mission and there were experience points as rewards, which made him a little entangled.
The improved system does not clearly display the experience value, but only uses an experience bar to represent it. This experience bar, which is similar to a progress bar, can be upgraded when it is filled. The specific number of 1,000 experience points can only be guessed.
Just because he entered the sphere of influence of the Elf Forest, Lin Tian collected all the human warriors and the dwarves as well. That's because on this continent, dwarves and elves are not the same family, but two different races. A certain house does not want to be mistaken for a slave-catching team by the conservative elves and be hunted to death. If possible, he himself would like to hide in the hero space. The sharp arrows of the elf hunter do not recognize people. The reason why flower demons are kept is because they are close to the forest and belong to the same family as the elves. On the one hand, they can also protect themselves and show that they are harmless. All the elf slaves have naturally been released, but Lin Tian does not have the ability to lift the magical restraints on them. He wonders if he will be able to lift them if he learns the water-based healing technique in the future (the healing technique in the game has an additional function that can remove an adverse effect, and advanced first-aid tents also have this ability).
A wooden arrow was inserted in front of the flower demon who was exploring the path in front of him. It was more of an obstruction than a direct war. This made Lin Tian breathe a huge sigh of relief. Say loudly in Elvish: "We have no ill intentions. We have rescued a group of elves from the vicious slave-catching team, and now we are escorting them back to you!" It may be the system's preferential treatment for people who have traveled through time. As long as Lin Tian has heard of the language, he can understand it and learn it immediately. On the way before, he specially approached these elf slaves to learn Elvish. Now, although the writing skills still need to be improved, there is no obstacle to basic communication.
Several elf hunters with full face tattoos flashed out in the dense forest ahead. These elves only wear additional tattoos when fighting or conducting military activities. This is their ancient tradition. Lin Tian raised his hands to show that he had no ill intentions, and at the same time motioned for one of the elf slaves to negotiate with them. After a while, more than 20 elves and even an old tree man stood out in the dense forest. They removed their disguises not far from Lin Tian's left and climbed up. The sudden action of this 6-meter-tall giant shocked a certain house who was so close but was completely unprepared...
These elven warriors picked up a dozen surviving elven slaves.
Tip: The escort mission is completed, and you will receive 1,000 experience and 1,000 gold coins.
Tip: Obtain a small amount of reputation from the mainland elves, and the current status is improved to indifferent.
The experience column has advanced by about 40%. This feeling of real progress makes Lin Tian feel refreshed. There is 37,000 gold left in the treasury.
What does it mean that there is also a small amount of reputation among mainland elves? A certain house guessed that it was probably because of the friendliness level. After it was improved, it was still just cold. Then it must have been hostile before, right? Should I wait until my reputation with them is high so that I can attack beautiful elf girls at will? Ha ha! Damn otaku has entered YY mode at an inappropriate time.
The reality is that the elf hunters politely asked the guests to stop and then turn around and walk away together! Otherwise, I will serve you with bows and arrows...
This immediately shattered the dream of being a dead otaku who was still imagining that he would be popular with the elf mm. I'd better go and conquer my own elf shooter mm first! They are much prettier than you. If you really want to summon them all, you village girls will definitely feel inferior to death! A man slandered.
Mission accomplished, no regrets!
Sa, a bandit!
